ClubClaim.schema:
CREATE TABLE `ClubClaim` (
  `id` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `club` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `state` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `applicant` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `submittedDate` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `claimStatus` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'Pending',
  `verificationStatus` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'Pending Review',
  `message` text COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci,
  `createdAt` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `updatedAt` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ON UPDATE CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

CompetitionResult.schema:
CREATE TABLE `CompetitionResult` (
  `id` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `eventId` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `eventName` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `club` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `state` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `stateCode` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `placement` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `place` int DEFAULT '1',
  `winnerDog` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `winnerDogReg` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `breed` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'Coonhound',
  `owner` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `participant` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `score` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT '0 Pts',
  `date` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'Published',
  `createdAt` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

DonationPledge.schema:
CREATE TABLE `DonationPledge` (

Event.schema:
CREATE TABLE `Event` (
  `id` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `federation` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `sport` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `type` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `club` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `clubId` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `state` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `stateCode` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `city` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `date` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `fee` double NOT NULL,
  `entriesCount` int DEFAULT '0',

  `startTime` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

LocalClub.schema:
CREATE TABLE `LocalClub` (
  `id` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,

  `logo` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `city` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,

Member.schema:
CREATE TABLE `Member` (
  `id` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `state` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `club` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `status` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'Active',

News.schema:
CREATE TABLE `News` (
  `id` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,

  `category` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,

Order.schema:
CREATE TABLE `Order` (
  `id` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `orderNumber` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `customerName` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `total` double NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'Completed',
  `itemsJson` text COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci,
  `createdAt` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `fulfillmentStatus` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'Processing',
  `payoutStatus` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'Pending',
  `clubId` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `customerEmail` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `trackingNumber` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `carrier` varchar(100) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `orderNumber` (`orderNumber`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

Product.schema:
CREATE TABLE `Product` (
  `id` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `name` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `price` double NOT NULL,
  `category` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci NOT NULL,
  `scopeChannel` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'NATIONAL',
  `scopeEntity` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `organizationType` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `organizationId` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `profit` double DEFAULT '0',
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci,
  `image` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `createdAt` datetime DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `wholesaleCost` double DEFAULT '0',
  `margin` double DEFAULT '0',
  `inStock` int DEFAULT '50',
  `vendorName` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'UHC National Organization',
  `source` varchar(191) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci DEFAULT 'UHC',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_general_ci

StateAssociation.schema:
